name: MIDAS Room Booking
shortDescription: A UK-developed room and resource booking system with cloud-hosted and self-hosted options, invoices, availability, bookings and configurable hire rates.
company: Blue Box Technical Services (trading name shown on MIDAS order material; no company number established in reviewed public material)
suitableContexts: Churches managing halls, rooms, resources and community hire
Facilities teams needing booking approvals, invoices and hire-rate rules
Churches choosing between supplier-hosted and self-hosted room-booking software

pricing.summary: MIDAS publishes price configuration by the number of venues, users, databases, edition and optional add-ons. Cloud-hosted use is available by monthly or annual subscription; self-hosted use is sold as a one-time licence with optional annual support. Obtain a current GBP quote for the chosen configuration, including VAT, payment, migration and support costs.

tiers.label: Cloud-hosted
tiers.detail: Supplier states that the price depends on venues, users, databases and optional add-ons.

tiers.label: Self-hosted
tiers.price: One-time licence plus optional annual support
tiers.detail: Supplier states that the software can run on the church’s own web-server infrastructure.

pricing.trialDetails: Supplier advertises a 30-day private trial with no credit card required.

gdprInformation: MIDAS publishes a DPA, privacy policy, retention policy and cloud-hosting terms. Its cloud terms identify the church as controller and MIDAS as processor. Current cloud choices include a European data centre and US locations, with UK backups; the supplier also offers self-hosting. Churches should select and document the actual data location, transfers, backup configuration, payment providers and exit process for the edition they buy.
integrations: Stripe and PayPal payment processing described in supplier policy
importExport: Supplier describes export of booking, client, invoice, resource and user data in Excel, CSV, tab-delimited text and XML
Supplier describes migration between cloud-hosted and self-hosted editions
support: Supplier offers a 30-day private trial and direct support material
Confirm support hours, incident response and any priority-support cost for the selected subscription

uk-development.value: Supplier describes MIDAS as developed and supported in Greater Manchester since 2005, with a UK ICO registration number ZA131245 stated in its legal information.

deployment-and-contract.value: Supplier offers cloud-hosted and self-hosted editions; its cloud terms identify the customer as controller and MIDAS as processor.

hosting-and-transfers.value: Supplier documents European, US East and US West live-data-centre choices for cloud hosting, plus UK and US backup arrangements.

exports-and-retention.value: Supplier documents data exports and a retention policy covering active databases, six-month backups, cancellation and trial-data handling.

pricing-and-trial.value: Supplier publishes configuration-based pricing and a 30-day no-card trial, with cloud subscriptions and self-hosted licences described separately.

editorial.assessment: MIDAS is a general UK room and resource-booking product rather than church-specific software, but its booking, client, invoice and hire-rate workflows can suit churches with a hall or multiple spaces. The meaningful choice is deployment: self-hosting may give a church greater control, while cloud hosting creates specific EU, UK and US data-location and backup questions. The product has unusually detailed public retention and export material; a church should still configure and document its own live data location and booking-data policy before use.
bestFor: Church halls and multi-room sites with regular internal or community bookings
Teams needing bookings, rates, resources and invoices in one workflow
Churches that require a self-hosted deployment option
strengths: UK-developed product with a long-running public support base
Published DPA, retention, export and hosting information
limitations: Not a church-specific management or pastoral-care platform
The reviewed public material does not establish a limited-company number for the trading operator
Cloud-hosted data can involve EU, UK and US locations, so configuration requires careful due diligence
Current price depends on configuration rather than a single published church package

procurementVerdict.problem: Managing rooms, resources, public hire and booking income without scattered calendars and spreadsheets
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK-developed system that allows a choice between supplier-hosted and self-hosted operation with detailed export and retention information
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Run the 30-day trial using non-sensitive test bookings, then model the selected data-centre and backup arrangement, hire rates, export, renewal and cancellation workflow
